title: Improving Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health

draft.title: Improving Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health
card: Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Organisations (ACCHOs) are health services run by the local Aboriginal community, for that community.
Self-determination means Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples make decisions about matters that affect their own lives and communities.
Programs that respect culture, language and kinship, and are led by the community, are more likely to be trusted and used. This can improve health outcomes.
Social justice means fairness and equal access to what people need for good health. Community-led programs promote it by giving a say to groups who have had worse health outcomes.
draft.remember: Community-led, culturally respectful programs build trust, improve health and promote fairness.

a.q: What best describes an Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Organisation?
opts: A health service run by the local Aboriginal community
A health service run by a state government department
A private clinic that charges patients for every visit
A national fund that pays for hospital care
a.why: An ACCHO is governed by the local Aboriginal community it serves, which is how it puts self-determination into practice. A government-run service may employ Aboriginal staff, but the community does not control it.
a.clue: Think about who makes the decisions.

b.q: A health service in a regional Victorian town changes its youth program after local Elders design it, and more teenagers start attending. Which is the most likely reason?
opts: Community leadership and respect for culture built trust
The program was cheaper than other services in town
Young people were required to attend by the service
Elders replaced the need for any trained health staff
b.why: Programs shaped by the community and its culture are more likely to be trusted and used. Cost and requirement are not supported by the card, and community leadership does not mean trained staff are not needed.
b.clue: Ask why people use a service they trust.
